items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: We met out here at 35th and State Street one night and went in a restaurant and sat down and talked.

ctx.x: Yeah, I knew both of them.

Yeah. Well, Baby was working with me at the entertainers. Well, he got me the job over there, see, with Carol Dixon. Well, I didn't care for it very much so I just quit that altogether and I wanted to build my band myself. So I just went to work and bought a car and went out on the north side and went around places and advertised the band. Finally, we got out of my work, we got six years and a half work of the band on the Gold Coast and over Chicago with the band under her name. The band never was under my name.…
Yeah, we could hear him already.
